mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Knowing your passive is stacking fills you with Determination.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions  grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max @MaxStacks@). He gains @PercentBonusADCalc@ increased Attack Damage per stack.

When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for @ReviveDuration@ seconds then revives with @RevivePercentCalc@ of his max Health.

Zaahen's revive has a @ReviveCooldownCalc@ second Cooldown.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zaahen can use The Darkin Glaive.
This unit has been knocked up.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing @BaseDamageCalc@ physical damage to nearby enemies.

Enemies at the edge of the slice take @BonusDamageCalc@ physical damage +@PercentHPDamage*100@% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals an additional @MonsterDamageBonus@ bonus physical damage to monsters.
Additional Maximum Health damage capped to @MonsterDamageCap@ against monsters.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zaahen can use The Darkin Glaive.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing @InitialDamage@ bonus physical damage and restoring @HealPercent*100@% of his max Health.

Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals @SecondHitDamage@ bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for @KnockUpDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Healing reduced to @MinionHealPercent*100@% against non-champions.
Deals an additional @MonsterDamagePercent*100@% bonus damage to monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Zaahen gains @ArmorPen*100@% %i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration.

Active: Zaahen rises, gaining @DamageReduction*100@% Damage Reduction while casting.

Zaahen then stabs downward, dealing @DamageEndCalc@ physical damage and restoring @HealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt to enemy champions as Health.
This unit is being pulled in.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zaahen stabs in a direction, dealing <physicalDamage>@InitialDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies hit, then <status>Pulls</status> them toward him, dealing <physicalDamage>@SecondaryDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
